title: Parameter - Attribute single quoted
description: The parameter is echoed in an HTML attribute, single quoted. i.e. <foo attribute='%q'>. An attacker can break out using a single quote.
php:
Parameter - Attribute Single Quoted

The q parameter is echoed inside a single-quoted HTML attribute.

Param: ?q=

⬇️ Reflected output (inspect the element below):

This element has data-value='' (single-quoted attribute).
Inspect this element to see the injection point.
objectives: Break out of the single-quoted attribute context using '.
Add an event handler like onmouseover or close the tag and add <script>.
hints: The attribute is enclosed in single quotes: data-value='[INPUT]'.
Break out with a single quote: ' onmouseover='alert(1).
